title: The Shortest War in History
hook: How could a full-scale war between nations end in just 38 minutes?
script: A full-scale war between Britain and Zanzibar broke out without any warning. The conflict was over before most citizens even realized it had started. In 1896, British warships shelled the palace of Zanzibar with high explosive artillery. The defenders returned fire using bronze cannons Queen Victoria had personally given them. In 38 minutes, Zanzibar lost five hundred men while Britain suffered zero deaths. Arranging the formal ceasefire actually took longer than the fighting itself. This meant Zanzibar was forced to pay Britain for the exact shells that destroyed them.
